unsaved.title: Discard your changes?
unsaved.body: You have changes that aren’t saved yet.

signedOut.title: You’re not signed in
signedOut.body: Sign in to manage devices, quiet hours and escalation. Appearance and language work without it.

sessionEnded.title: Your session ended
sessionEnded.body: Sign in again to carry on. What you changed here is kept.

sessionPage.description: Who this browser is signed in as.

appearance.description: How Chimesail looks and which language it speaks.
appearance.browserOnly: These choices apply to this browser only.

quietHours.description: Chimesail holds notifications during these hours.
quietHours.emptyDetail: Notifications can reach you at any time.
quietHours.timezoneHelp: The hours follow this time zone, wherever you are.
quietHours.criticalHint: Critical decisions that arrive in these hours still reach you.
quietHours.dayTaken: This day already belongs to another schedule.
quietHours.overnightNote: Overnight hours: they start on each day you choose and end the next morning, at {{end}}.

issue.badTime: Enter a start and an end time.
issue.sameTime: Start and end must be different times.

quietHours.removeBody: Notifications will reach you at any time on those days.
quietHours.stale: Couldn’t refresh quiet hours. Showing what loaded earlier.
quietHours.partialBody: Couldn’t confirm {{days}}. Your changes are still here; try again.
quietHours.unconfirmedBody: Chimesail couldn’t read your quiet hours back. Check your connection, then try again. Your changes are still here.

escalation.description: If a critical decision goes unanswered, Chimesail tries these channels in order. Only critical decisions escalate; others expire when their time is up.
escalation.emptyDetail: An unanswered critical decision expires without trying another channel.
escalation.addHint: Chimesail tries it after the channels above.
escalation.nothingToAdd: Every channel your devices offer is already in the order.
escalation.notOffered: No device offers this channel right now.
escalation.timing: Each step waits 5 minutes for your answer before the next one is tried.
escalation.notAppliedBody: Chimesail still has: {{order}}. Your changes are still here; try again.
escalation.unconfirmedBody: Chimesail couldn’t read the order back. Check your connection, then try again. Your changes are still here.
escalation.emptyConfirmBody: Critical decisions you miss will expire without trying another channel.

sources.description: Choose which apps may notify you, and the lowest urgency that gets through.
sources.emptyDetail: When an app starts sending you notifications, it will appear here.
sources.saveFailedDetail: It’s back to how it was. Try again.
